risks.risk: Individual keys or buttons may be unresponsive.
risks.proof: A video of a 'chromatic scale' test (playing every key in order) and pressing menu buttons.

risks.risk: The LCD screen may have 'vinegar syndrome', dead pixels, or a failed backlight.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the screen while the unit is powered on.

risks.risk: The power adapter may be missing or faulty.
risks.proof: A photo of the original power adapter.

proof_requests: A video of the keyboard powered on, playing a demo song to test speakers and the main board.
A video showing every key being pressed to confirm they all trigger sound.
A clear photo of the LCD screen while the unit is turned on.

response.reason: The model is clearly identified. Due to the visible heavy wear, yellowing, and lack of proof of operation, it is priced at the worst-case scenario of a non-functional unit for parts.
